target_customer: Enterprises and banks with heavy document workflows such as KYC, invoices, claims and loans
problem: Document-heavy processes remain manual because documents are messy scans and handwritten forms. EigenPal automates them with AI workflows tested on historical documents first.
business_model: B2B software with cloud or on-prem deployment, plus usage pricing for OpenParser from $1 per 1,000 pages

founders.name: Matej Novak
previous_startups: Three-time founder of B2B AI companies (unnamed on YC page)

competitors.name: Rossum
competitors.what: AI invoice and AP document processing, now part of Coupa

competitors.name: Docsumo
competitors.what: IDP for financial services, loans, claims and KYC

technical_complexity.rationale: Document extraction on messy scans uses OCR and LLMs; evals, lineage and on-prem deployment add engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many IDP vendors exist; bank deployments with on-prem requirements create some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rossum became part of Coupa; EigenPal outcome unknown.

market_need_then: Roundups from 2025 and 2026 list many IDP tools, showing steady demand; EigenPal reports work with two large European banks on loan automation.

identity.logo: Logo files exist; design not described
identity.visual_style: Product suite with Eigen-prefixed names (EigenSearch, EigenEval)
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise, human control emphasized

branding.brand_signature: Open-source DOCX editor and Eigen-prefix product family
branding.community_and_virality: Open-source docx-editor on GitHub around 1,557 stars per a listing snapshot.

brand_strength.rationale: Open-source editor builds developer awareness, but the name is confused with Eigen (a Benchmark-backed startup) and Eigen Labs in searches.

outcome_analysis: EigenPal is an Active Winter 2026 company with no outcome yet. It has a credible founding team, bank customers it names, and an open-source developer funnel. The IDP market is crowded and no confirmed funding is public.
notes: Unverified: PitchBook snippet shows about $500K raised with a seed dated March 2026 and no amounts per round; StartupHub says no announced round. Not recorded as rounds. Locations conflict (San Francisco, Newark DE, London). Competitor sources are 2025 to 2026 comparison pages rather than launch coverage. Founder prior employers for Novak not found. Completeness pass: the seed dated 2026-03 rests on a single database (PitchBook, no amount per round); trackers give about 500K total, likely the YC deal, and StartupHub says no announced round.
